definitions: An impression left by a foot or shoe on a surface.
The area of ground occupied by a building or a group of buildings.
The impact of something on the environment, measured in terms of the amount of resources used and waste produced.
The area within which a satellite or broadcast signal can be received.
examples: We saw a footprint in the sand.
The building has a large footprint.
Reducing our carbon footprint is important.
The satellite's footprint covers most of Europe.
